title: Telemetry dispatch record
description: State-machine record for one agent dispatch: pre-spawn (status=in_flight) and post-spawn (status in {completed, failed, refused, timed_out}) writes share this shape, consolidating the source dispatch-record + spawn-meta pair into one loadout event schema. The spawn env block (spawn_env) carries whatever identity/attribution keys the deployment's spawn convention injects — loadout does not enumerate specific env var names here, that set is deployment-defined. additionalProperties:false, mechanical whitelist.

dispatch_id.description: Opaque identifier for this dispatch, stable across its pre-spawn and post-spawn writes. Shape is caller-defined.

status.description: Dispatch lifecycle state. in_flight: pre-spawn write, child session not yet resolved. Terminal states carry completed_ts + result_summary.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this write was made.

target_session_id.description: The spawned child session identifier, once known. null on the pre-spawn write.

completed_ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the dispatch reached a terminal status. Present only on terminal writes.

result_summary.description: Short, non-prose outcome summary. Detailed artifacts live outside the telemetry record.

spawn_env.description: Opaque map of the identity/attribution env keys injected into the spawned subprocess. Loadout carries this through without interpreting individual keys — mapping specific keys to meaning is a deployment concern.
